candidate.scope: Q6 selected down only; retained Q4 wave-column down held constant
candidate.geometry: 64 output columns x 32 routed rows, local128
candidate.row_mapping: waves 0/1 own rows 0-15 and columns 0-31/32-63; waves 2/3 repeat the column halves for rows 16-31
candidate.quartet_variant: quartet leader decodes four Q6 columns and distributes them with four wave shuffles
candidate.direct_variant: each lane decodes its own Q6 column without wave shuffles
candidate.tradeoff: both variants duplicate streamed Q6 weight decode across the two row halves to remove the 4096-byte shared weight cache

validation.red: The expanded Q6 fixture failed on the missing row-half wrapper selector.
validation.green: Six Q6 configurations passed the CPU-reference quality gate; both candidates were BF16-byte identical to production.

protocol.scope: one resident owner; matrix512/attention128; one 128-row warmup per mode; seven counterbalanced synchronized pp512 repetitions

decision.retain: Q6 row-vector production with one shared weight decode per workgroup
decision.remove: both Q6 row-half kernels, symbols, wrapper selectors, runtime modes, and tests
decision.reason: Even without wave shuffles, duplicating Q6 weight decode across row halves costs more than eliminating shared-weight LDS.
